title: oes-quantum-binaural-lab: classical toy simulation of Bell-correlation Monte Carlo, scalar metrics ledger, and digital stereo loopback
description:
oes-quantum-binaural-lab is an offline, dependency-free Python prototype with three deliberately separate classical software lanes: a classical metrics ledger (1,024 scalar slots, not an OES detector), a Bell-correlation Monte Carlo model (stipulated cosine correlation with synthetic readout error; no quantum state or circuit evolution), and digital stereo loopback (in-memory multitone calibration; no audio hardware).

Evidence. All outputs are SYNTHETIC and seed-controlled. Bundled default-run reports use seed 1731. CHSH is an approximate simulator check only.

Limits. Classical toy simulation on an ordinary computer: “membrane” is a metaphor and “observer” means measurement readout. No quantum hardware or analog audio calibration is involved.
notes: Evidence status: SYNTHETIC classical toy simulation; no quantum hardware is used. Commercial licensing: see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md.
